name: cot-deep-review
description: Autonomous asynchronous code review & refactoring driven by Chain-of-Thought prompting over the Groq API (llama-3.3-70b-versatile).

cotReviewer.groqApiKey.markdownDescription: Groq Cloud **Developer API Key** used to authenticate requests to `https://api.groq.com`. Create one at [console.groq.com/keys](https://console.groq.com/keys). If left empty, the extension prompts for the key the first time a review runs.

scripts.test: esbuild test/groqService.test.ts test/webview.test.ts test/pipeline.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --outdir=dist-test --log-level=warning && node dist-test/groqService.test.js && node dist-test/webview.test.js && node dist-test/pipeline.test.js
